summary.en: A fast top-down monster brawl — endless medieval waves charge in, and positioning is everything.
summary.zh: 俯视角快节奏怪物割草，一波波中世纪怪物冲上来，走位最关键。

description.en: Move with WASD and your cannon auto-fires at whatever the mouse points at. Clear a wave, face the next, grab pickups to power up, and stay alive as long as you can for a bigger score.
description.zh: WASD 移动、鼠标瞄准自动射击，清完一波刷下一波，靠拾取道具强化，撑得越久分越高。

howto.en: WASD to move, mouse to aim.

tip.en: High-adrenaline runs of three to five minutes — a perfect 'five-minute break' entry point. The assets are mostly sprite atlases, so the first load is a touch heavy; serve them from a CDN.
tip.zh: 爽感强、单局时间短（3-5 分钟），适合做「摸鱼五分钟」入口。资源以图集为主，首次加载略大，建议上 CDN。
